about: Next-token probabilities of Qwen3.5-2B (teacher) and the untrained Qwen3.5-0.8B (student) at one answer position, measured 2026-11-13 with transformers, thinking off, teacher-forced on the 2B's greedy answer. The query is made up, not an xLAM row. Each model's probabilities are its softmax over the full 248,320-token vocabulary at T = 1.
query: Give me the forecast for Lisbon.
